name: tesira-web-control
description: Control Biamp Tesira main and subwoofer volume from a phone or tablet browser. Requires a reachable Tesira DSP with Telnet enabled. Set your instance tags and channel counts during installation, or change them in the dashboard. Gang links dashboard channel sliders; it does not change DSP block ganging. Trusted local networks only; no authentication. Preset selection is planned.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Stores saved dashboard settings. Do not use the source checkout directory for a new installation.

variables.name: DSP address
variables.description: Required: your Tesira control-network IP address or hostname.

variables.name: Main instance tag
variables.description: Initial main-level instance tag. Case sensitive. Saved dashboard settings take priority.

variables.name: Main channels
variables.description: Initial number of main channels, 1 through 32; controls channels 1 through N.

variables.name: Gang main channels
variables.description: Initial dashboard linking: true sets channels together; false exposes individual sliders.

variables.name: Subwoofer instance tag
variables.description: Initial subwoofer instance tag. Case sensitive. Saved dashboard settings take priority.

variables.name: Subwoofer channels
variables.description: Initial number of subwoofer channels, 1 through 32.

variables.name: Gang subwoofer channels
variables.description: Initial dashboard linking for the subwoofer channels.

variables.name: Main maximum dB
variables.description: Maximum allowed main volume; match your DSP block limits.

variables.name: Subwoofer maximum dB
variables.description: Maximum allowed subwoofer volume; match your DSP block limits.

variables.name: App user ID
variables.description: Non-root UID that owns saved settings.

variables.name: App group ID
variables.description: Non-root GID that owns saved settings.
